name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: The full legal name of the pensioner applying for the health card.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as recorded in official government documents or PPO.

name: Pension Payment Order (PPO) Number
whatItMeans: The unique identification number assigned to the government pensioner.
whatToEnter: Enter your valid PPO number issued by the competent authority.

name: Date of Birth
whatItMeans: The chronological age and birth date of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

name: Gender
whatItMeans: The biological sex or gender identity of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Select your gender from the available options (Male, Female, Other).

name: Department Name
whatItMeans: The specific government department from which the applicant retired.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of the state or central government department of your retirement.

name: Pensioner Type
whatItMeans: The classification of the pension being received (e.g., Service Pension, Family Pension).
whatToEnter: Select the appropriate category of your pension.

name: Residential Address
whatItMeans: The current permanent residential address of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your complete address including house number, street, district, mandal, and pin code.

name: Mobile Number
whatItMeans: The active contact number of the applicant for receiving updates and OTPs.

name: Aadhaar Number
whatItMeans: The unique 12-digit identification number issued by UIDAI to the applicant.

name: Family Member Details
whatItMeans: Information regarding the dependents to be included under the health card.
whatToEnter: Provide the name, age, gender, and relationship of each eligible dependent family member.

name: Photograph and Signature
whatItMeans: The digital or physical image and specimen signature of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Upload a recent passport-sized photograph and your specimen signature.
